record.notes: MOSTI's press release of 20 Sep 2024 says Deputy Prime Minister Fadillah Yusof launched the guidelines that day; the MASTIC publication page dates them September 2024. They were developed as an action plan of the National AI Roadmap 2021-2025 (AI-RMAP), with input from the working committee of the National Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence Committee (NBAIC), Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, industry and civil society. The guidelines call themselves a living document to be reviewed and updated regularly and say they will be made available in Malay and English. The National AI Action Plan 2026-2030 cites them as published by MOSTI in 2023. AI Malaysia's voluntary AI Code of Ethics (AICE) puts their seven principles into practice.

verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. Stored and read: the MASTIC (MOSTI) publication page (mastic.mosti.gov.my, copy of 18 Oct 2026; its text differs from the copy of 11 Oct 2026 only in the page's last-modified line), which gives the title, 'Sep 2024' and the type 'MOSTI Related Policies'; the guidelines PDF embedded in that page (140 pages, stored again in this run), which confirms the title, the publisher and the voluntary character and carries no date; MOSTI's Malay press release of 20 Sep 2024 on the launch (mosti.gov.my, stored again in this run); and AI Malaysia's AICE page (ai.gov.my, the secondary source). Because the guidelines carry no date and the issuer's publication page gives only the month, date_published is 2024-09 and the launch day from the press release is in the notes. The National AI Action Plan's citation of a 2023 publication rests on that plan's text (MY-03), not on a file of this record.
